reviewsWithKeywords.title: Icon of Lampedusa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: World famous as it is considered among the 10 most beautiful on the planet and in 2013 the people of Tripadvisor elected it first. I do not know if this assessment is correct (you should have seen all the beaches in the world to judge and then each of us has its own criteria) but undoubtedly it is a beautiful beach: a long and wide beach of fine white sand, shallow water for dozens of meters, crystal clear and wonderful colors, mainly various shades of green. Here you do not swim but walk in the water back and forth, magnetized by that thin strip of submerged sand that connects the beach to the Isola dei Conigli, which can be easily reached by walking in the water but where it is forbidden to climb, as if enchanted by so much beauty and the emotion of being in an exclusive place, very interesting Nature, for the presence of the aforementioned islet and the absence of establishments and other buildings (except for the villa of Domenico Modugno, located in a recess of the beach but practically hidden).  To reach this paradise you have to walk a path of about 800 meters, however well arranged that is therefore very well done (perhaps a little 'tiring on the way back since it is uphill) and that starts from the road of West, where there is a bar / refreshment and parking (for a fee) as well as the stop of the Blue Line Bus and access controls: the beach is in fact limited in number and the entrance must be booked online in advance; there are two shifts, morning (8:30-13:30) or afternoon (14:30-19:30); the morning shift has the disadvantage of making the path uphill at the hottest time; the booking procedure is quite simple and intuitive, and works well, you just have to make the reservation in advance, which is difficult to quantify as it depends on the period. In any case, it is good to know that if you can not book on the chosen day because both rounds are already sold out, there are a hundred places available without reservation and that are assigned on the basis of the order of presentation at the access box (so if you want to be sure to enter just show up at the box "access not booked" well in advance of the start of the shift, morning or afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A fairy tale!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 🐇 to book through the website a little in advance. Two slots available: 8:30-13:30 or 14:30-19:30. Only 2 bookings per week for 2 people are allowed. The access involves walking a path for about 10/15 minutes (sneakers recommended), not feasible with the stroller. At the entrance there is a small bar that also rents umbrellas and bathrooms for a fee. At the back of the bar you queue if not in possession of a reservation, in front of the bar with reservation. Cars and scooters can be parked for a fee (scooter €5 for the half day, otherwise €1 per hour), if you do not have a reservation they recommend making the payment only after being sure to get off. One part of the beach is intended for those who have an umbrella, the other only for those who have a towel to lay. The sea slopes slowly and has spectacular colors, the sand is fine.  If the period is favorable, you can witness the hatching of the eggs of the turtles caretta caretta.IMPORTANT! Remember to have water, food, sunscreen and a headgear with you (if it is windy it is impossible to plant the umbrella) as once you arrive at the beach there is nothing.
I recommend booking online to access the beach of the Rabbits, the most beautiful and fascinating beach of the island!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I were very disappointed with the organization that deals with beach reservations. As per regulations we booked the entrance a few days before, through the website, with entry at 9.30 am. On the day of entry unfortunately we had a problem with the scooter we had rented and we showed up at the rabbit beach box to pay for the tickets at 10.00 am, thirty minutes late then. Apologizing to the girl in charge of the entrance, we explained the situation sure that there would be no problems. To his surprise, however, in a very annoying tone, he tells us that unfortunately we can no longer enter, despite having booked, because they sell tickets to those who arrive before 9.30 without a reservation. It seems to me to be truly absurd that when faced with a delay of 30 minutes of two people, they are told to leave, in a bad way moreover, I repeat, despite having booked. Unfortunately my husband and I were there for 1 day only so we did not have the chance to see the beach, on the other hand we saw others just as beautiful. We will definitely not return as courtesy and organization were definitely absent.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rabbit Beach: an earthly paradise (with some care)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Spiaggia dei Conigli is undoubtedly one of the jewels of the Mediterranean, a place where unspoilt nature gives unforgettable emotions. Its fame is well deserved, with crystal clear waters and golden sand that invite relaxation and contemplation.Key tips:Reservation required: Throughout the summer, access to the beach is regulated and requires advance booking, especially in July and August, when the island is particularly crowded. Plan your visit well in advance to secure your place in this paradise.Time slots: The beach is accessible in two time slots:Morning: from 8:30 to 13:30. The water is particularly clear and crystal clear, ideal for snorkelers and divers. However, the ascent from the beach requires a walk of about 20 minutes uphill, under the sun.Afternoon: from 14:30 to 19:30. The water is slightly less transparent, but still gorgeous. Sunset from the beach is a magical experience.Prepare for the ascent: Regardless of the time slot you choose, the ascent from the beach takes a bit of effort. Bring enough water with you and wear comfortable shoes.No sunbeds and umbrellas: the beach is not equipped, you can bring only your own umbrella.What makes Rabbit Beach special:The natural beauty: The landscape is breathtaking, with colors ranging from the intense turquoise of the water to the white of the sand.Biodiversity: The beach is a protected area, where you can spot different marine and terrestrial species.Despite the need for booking and the somewhat challenging ascent, the Spiaggia dei Conigli is definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A corner of paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unforgettable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are an expert in Sardinian beaches or Apulian beaches, the beautiful Sardinian sea or the beautiful Salento sea, know that the Spiaggia de l'Isola dei Conigli is another thing! This is not a beautiful beach, it is not a beautiful sea, this is paradise. It's another world, perhaps also because you have to walk, sweat, get there and enter this world. The moment you look out over this cove the colors are fantastic of a blue you have never seen unless you have been to the Maldives or other exotic places for the super rich. I can assure you that all the photos you see on the web are not realistic, they do not show the real colors of that sea. They can't reproduce the emotions you get when you're there.On the shore, even in just one meter of water there are a myriad of fish including breams, salps, murmurs, amberjacks even 50 cm long... in short, you are in an open-air aquarium, you are in the marine nature reserve of Lampedusa! Unforgettable

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Tropical Dream on Sicily
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spiaggia dei Conigli, or Rabbit Beach, is located on the idyllic island of Lampedusa, part of the Italian island group Pelagie. With its crystal clear turquoise water and soft, white sandy beaches, Spiaggia dei Conigli is considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. For anyone who dreams of a perfect beach day, this place is a true paradise.Natural BeautyWhen you first arrive at Spiaggia dei Conigli, you will be welcomed by a spectacular view. The long, white sandy beach embraces the clear water, and the cliffs surrounding the beach provide a dramatic and scenic background. The landscape is amazing and it feels like you have entered a postcard world. The beach is also surrounded by protected areas, which are home to a variety of animal species, including sea turtles breeding here, making the place even more unique and giving a feeling of being in harmony with nature.Activities and RelaxationSpiaggia dei Conigli is perfect for both relaxation and activity. The water is calm and clear, making it ideal for swimming, snorkeling and other water sports activities. Snorkeling here is an experience in itself, as it is possible to see colorful fish and exciting marine life. For those looking for a more relaxed day, there is plenty of space to lie down on the sand and enjoy the sun.However, it is important to note that the beach can become very popular, especially during the high season. It is recommended to arrive early in the day to ensure a good seat. Also, there are no facilities directly on the beach, so it is advisable to bring your own food and drinks.AvailabilityTo get to Spiaggia dei Conigli, take a short walk from the parking lot. The tour takes about 20-30 minutes and is a simple but scenic route. The somewhat challenging access makes the beach remain relatively calm compared to more accessible beaches, which is a big part of the charm.ConclusionSpiaggia dei Conigli is a hidden gem that really gives you a feeling of being in paradise. The natural beauty, the crystal clear waters and the relaxing atmosphere make this place a must for anyone visiting Lampedusa. Whether you’re looking for adventure, relaxation or a romantic day by the sea, Spiaggia dei Conigli will exceed your expectations. This is a place you won’t forget, and that will definitely give you memories for a lifetime.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed twice at the beach of the Rabbits, I state that you have to book the day and time of day (morning or afternoon) for the visit. The beach is a nature reserve so it is forbidden to leave rubbish or anything else, you can bring your umbrella but not the awnings. We also had the pleasure of seeing the hatching of a Caretta Caretta turtle egg, which, thanks to the help of the boys of the Lega Ambiente was able to reach the shore and jump into the sea. It was a really great experience!The visit to this beach is not recommended for those with particular health problems (see the site) or struggles to walk, because to reach it there is a nice piece of road with pebbles and stones and to go back is all uphill. Going by boat, however, you can admire it only from a distance and then wanting to swim.Parking is on the street, in September the cost was 7.5 euros all afternoon from 2.30 pm to 7 pm. At the entrance you will find a small kiosk selling food and drinks I would say very well cared for.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is definitely beautiful, although I found it overrated compared to other reviews read here and elsewhere. The same type of "view" is also found in other Italian locations, perhaps less famous.    The sore point of August is the absurd amount of people who give access to the beach that does not allow in any way to enjoy it serenely.  Rudeness is unfortunately king. To reach the beach there is a dirt path of about 15/20 minutes, closed shoes are recommended. There are no beach facilities for food or drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach reachable with a 15-minute walk downhill. The line for those who booked runs very fast. Umbrellas can only be used in one area of the beach. Beach not equipped but has a bar at the entrance

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful but to book , we did it two months before and it is good because some tourists could not see it. It deserves to see it from above and swim in its crystal clear waters, for those who are lucky could meet some turtle that comes out of the sand, we were obviously not 😅. One part of the beach is accessible with only beach towels, the other side also umbrellas. The walk to the beach and in good 15 min walk under the sun, arm yourself with a hat and do not carry too much weight. During routes there are benches to stop in the shade, however admiring the enchanting panorama the climb passes quickly. We have chosen Reservation at 8:30/13:30 , the other slot is from 14:30/19:30. Obviously there are no beaches or bars but at the entrance, before the route, there is a kiosk for drinks and more.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: SPECTACULAR OF NATURE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is really a paradise on earth... surreal from how beautiful it is, if you come to lampedusa is a must.Reservation is required on the site to access it, Recommendation the time slot of the afternoon 14.30 / 19.30 because the climb back in the sun at 14 is not the best.the path is not long; it lasts about 15 minutes and shoes are recommended because with flip-flops you slide, parking is charged € 5 and there is the possibility to rent umbrellasthanks to the limited access there is no overcrowding, it is very quiet and not everyone is stuck.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: S T R E P I T O S A
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arrived for the morning shift without Reservation (sold out online, 150 seats for non-reserved).We queue (not the first row you find on the left (are booked) the row on the right and wait confidently....ok done you enter.Walk, walk and walk (tracking shoes or gymnastics recommended not to get hurt) for 30 minutes.... but then you appear in all its immense, infinite, rare, amazing, extraordinary beauty!!!Take your breath away!!!!!!Modugno was right: it is the pool of God😍.  ANDATECI!!!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The wonder
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I return after six years to this beach that you can not miss if you are in Lampedusa. The last time I was there it was free and I had done all day, now you can only do half a day. We did not book there was no place, we went in the morning Recommendation to go around 7.30, get in line, they will start to drop off after 8.30. Recommendation to go in the morning because waiting in the sun for the afternoon would be too hard. Go down with the tennis, remember that you have to bring the umbrella or rent it at the parking bar which is for a fee, there is no bathroom and bar below so bring the necessary and you can not smoke. It's 6 minutes of descent and 10 minutes of ascent, feasible for anyone. We returned in the afternoon, at 17 descents without any line without any problem but of course Recommendation in the morning for the colors of the sea. Not to be missed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Open air swimming pool
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was at this beach without Reservation presented at 8 immense row at 08:40 I was already descending the 800 meter path that leads to the show the view takes your breath away The water has spectacular colors to return as I did at 16:30 just the time to take another bath really deserves

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dream made beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is little to say, the beach symbol of Lampedusa, an earthly paradise: clear water, white sand.Perhaps to achieve maximum success we need to reduce a little the number of people allowed access in the two shifts(P.S. Make your online reservation to access)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ONE THING IS SURE I'LL COME BACK
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Spiaggia dei Conigli, being a natural reserve of the island that is part of the Pelagie archipelago in Sicily, is considered one of the wonders of the world. “White sandy beaches, turquoise water and refreshing sea breeze. Take a good shoe and prepare for a walk of about twenty minutes to reach it, but when you “come there, you will feel that you are not on Earth”, it was our feeling and you do not want to come away...ONE THING IS SURE I'LL COME BACK

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise on earth... pristine place and absolute relaxation ..Fresh fish and nice people.. To return absolutely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rudeness and disorganization of staff
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Obviously the location is 5 stars, needless to say the sea that is certainly one of the most beautiful ever seen. Beyond that my experience was bad. I regularly made the reservation to enter the afternoon slot but arrived there they would not let us in, justifying the fact that we were well past the deadline to enter. My mistake ok, maybe I was distracted when I received the booking confirmation email. Or maybe they are not too clear since like me there were many other people who came "beyond" the bell. After a heated discussion we still managed to enter but I still wanted to report the rudeness and ignorance of a girl at the entrance, who mocked mocking anyone, raising the tone considerably, showing her professionalism in its entirety.Even on the beach I witnessed shocking scenes, staff running around arrogantly mocking tourists... I was really upset.I believe that places with a strong tourist attraction like this should be given in management to those who really have quality and great professionalism to do it, no to improvised...I really hope for a change of course, maybe next time I will find more welcome.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A dream beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spectacular beach. Easy enough access and very clean water and full of fish. Almeno una volta bisogna vederla!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach of Rabbits
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise on earth, never seen such beauty. I'll never forget her. Too bad for the queue to do, I would have come back another time before leaving. Once in a lifetime must be seen

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely place, crystal clear and warm water, breathtaking scenery around, the wild beauty of the place makes you forget the slight effort to reach it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only this beach is worth the trip. It is a spectacle, every time it leaves you speechless. To see both in the morning and in the afternoon because the lights are different as they change according to the wind. Right that it is a nature reserve to allow limited access and preserve this wonder. Ps: road feasible even with flip-flops.Excessive only the price of parking the car.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's the most beautiful beach I've ever seen. Going down you are left speechless and with bated breath so much the unexpected beauty that opens to the view. The sea is a mix of wonderful colors, more crystal clear than a pool. We booked through the site but access is also allowed to a limited number of people without reservation. The ascent is a bit challenging and I do not recommend it in the hottest hours. At the top there is a small bar where you can find some refreshment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth at least once
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful, pristine beach with lots of fish, even some dogs on the beach. It is not possible to access it with deckchairs, lifebuoys etc. but only the umbrella that you have to bring from home or rent upstairs. The descent is almost 900 m and the ascent is a bit hard, but sometimes there are small shaded areas to rest. It is always better to go down with shoes or at most hiking sandals. You can stop only half a day and it is free. But parking in June is charged € 1.50 per hour. for once it is worth it. There are no services, lifeguard bars at beach level but only at the top of the climb.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MERAVIGLIOSA!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I turned enough, but such a beautiful place I had never seen it! Indescrivibile!Da visitare e rimandare incantati!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Uuuuuuu
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A bomb!!! There's a walk to do but it's about 800m, nothing impossible... the beach and the sea repay the effort!!! Simply breathtaking and there was also a rough sea.... I imagine when it is calm

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Lampedusa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We go for three consecutive days of our short holiday on the island, we immediately understand that it is the most popular half, it is very easy to park and there is no need for a reservation, but it is a bit early as it is the first week of May.To reach the beach there is a cobbled path which, honestly, in the sun, going up it is very tiring. The beach and the sea are beautiful, it's a shame about an old rusty boat that is dangerous for children located on the side of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: But what do Italians go to the Maldives for?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I thought that "Paradise" was above; but instead it is below, on the same level as us and reachable not necessarily by having performed good deeds on Earth. It is the "Rabbit Beach", with the islet of the same name opposite, Lampedusa : a hymn to the beauty of Nature at sea. And so Sicily adds this authentic "enchantment" to its historical, archaeological and artistic wonders!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It will leave you speechless...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Said and said again... but I'll say it again: Conigli beach is Heaven on Earth. To be preserved. Crazy colours...sea to drink...extreme beauty.On the beach you have to follow rules (rightly so); cigarettes (rightly) are not allowed. The Legambiente volunteers do an excellent job. Great.You can enter for shifts that can be booked online (do it well in advance). There are 2 shifts per day and, if desired, there is also a queue for those without reservations. Places are not unlimited.You will not regret it. A single recommendation: respect for this Paradise. I would go back 10 thousand times.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: heaven on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just amazing, I hope they continue to preserve it.Crystal clear water, the approach from the path is very suggestive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: UNIQUE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: God's swimming pool. That's how Modugno defines it, well he's not entirely wrong......best beach I've ever visited

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best time to visit it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: if you are lucky with the weather, October is the best time to go to Lampedusa, no chaos, pleasant temperatures, warm and crystal clear sea.Then taking the walk to get to the rabbit beach under a beautiful sun but without the torrid climate is certainly more advisable.Stunning island that should be protected (in addition to the rabbit island) to avoid the reckless abandonment of various rubbish on the coasts and roadsides.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An experience to repeat
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Splendid beach with crystal clear water, the colors of the sea are enchanting, the climb up under the 1pm sun is a bit challenging but it's worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven is here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise experience... Color of the water, care of the beach, protection of the fauna: these are the aspects that I appreciated most.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Suddenly Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Simply a paradise.Simple booking, convenient parking and a path where every step opens up to a glimpse of a picture that only nature could create.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A true paradiseCrystal clear water, beach and spectacular viewsSimple booking to makeYou go down a path for 10 minutes and you find yourself facing a sea that leaves you breathless

reviewsWithKeywords.title: heaven on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was at Conigli beach in mid-August and there really aren't enough photos or words to give an idea of what a natural spectacle it is. I was very happy that I had to book and that there was a limited number of places, otherwise I don't think I would have enjoyed it so much. Stunning sea, not too crowded, very fine sandy beach. The walk to get there is slightly tiring when you go up (especially in the hottest hours I recommend lots of fresh water). A mandatory stop for anyone coming to Lampedusa!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Enchanting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is a reason why it is among the most beautiful beaches in the world.Entrance must be booked online. Better to do it in advance so as not to risk losing the chance to visit it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An authentic enchantment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have seen, with a wonderful sea. It is difficult to describe in words the wonder of this place. Absolutely worth seeing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise in Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Having arrived on the island for two days with my husband, we decide not to wait any longer and immediately go and visit what is the main reason for our trip here! Well what can I tell you... I don't know where else in the world I can see a sea like this... the photos don't do it justice, I'm not very capable of it, if my daughter had been with me she would have given space to her passion! Unfortunately, it's worth the expensive flight. Heaven on earth, you are now in my heart.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful. If you don't have a reservation, the day with the lowest attendance is Saturday followed by Sunday. In the morning there is less queue

reviewsWithKeywords.title: fantastic show
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Area with limited access.Paid street parking (7.00 euros for the car – 3.50 for the motorbike).For access methods, it is essential to inform yourself well in advance on the Lega Ambiente website and to book online equally in advance to obtain the barcode needed to enter (free).The visit is allowed only for half a day (either morning or afternoon) once a week.It is worth knowing that it is still possible to access the beach even without a reservation, but this is allowed to "only" 150 people per shift (morning from 8.30am - afternoon from 2.30pm).From the entrance checkpoint to the beach you go down for about 15 minutes.From the beach to the check, on the way back up (under the hot sun) it takes at least 20/25 minutes.The beach is divided into three areas: the first part (wider) also accessible with an umbrella, the second only with towels (no umbrella), the third inaccessible for environmental protection.The beach is not equipped and there is no possibility of purchasing water or food (bringing at least one bottle of water is strongly recommended).Once all these complications are over… the show is fantastic and totally worth the trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nothing to say about the breathtaking view but I for my part would ask for it completely because sooner or later man will make it ugly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A daydream.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen.Crystal clear water. A paradise, a dream. Gorgeous, pristine sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A highly recommended paradise for experiencing the best holidays in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to enjoy the most beautiful sea in the world, all you have to do is come to Lampedusa and above all visit the rabbit island: be careful, you need to book in advance as being a reserve, entrances are limited, I'll just tell you that two eyes are not enough to admire the beauty of the crystalline and clear sea, the Sicilian Caribbean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Never seen such a wonderful sea, beautiful beach, a real swimming pool. The wait and the journey to get there is nerve-wracking but it's worth it. I did the route wearing flip flops, you just need to walk slowly and in 10 minutes you arrive at the beach to enjoy the beauty of nature. Rating 10/10 unique experience

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beauty of the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is truly the most beautiful part of the island, thanks above all to the landscape but also to the lack of urbanization that has been prevented there (although I still managed to build a beautiful building facing the sea). Limited access, to be booked in advance during the busiest periods of tourists otherwise you risk not entering.Applause to the legambiente staff who try to keep the area as intact as possible for the life cycle of the turtles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top beach. The images speak.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not much to say, one of the most beautiful beaches I've seen. The images speak. Beautiful. We booked directly there after a bit of waiting, you take a walk in the sun but not too demanding and then you go to the beach. All very beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Book access to the beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You need to book your visit on the appropriate site, choosing either the morning or afternoon shift. The first has the drawback that at 1pm, with the sun shining brightly, you find yourself walking the uphill path and it is very tiring; the afternoon shift is better, so the ascent takes place in the late afternoon, at a more bearable temperature. However, in addition to the reserved places, there are also 150 free places, so at the end of June it was possible to enter even without a reservation; in August I imagine it's impossible. These limited accesses are however useful because they have managed to keep the beauty of this beach intact which remains one of the most beautiful I have ever seen (and I have seen many). Bring cash to pay for parking because they don't have a POS.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with crystal clear sea. The idea of regulated access is nice but in my opinion there are still too many people, they should reduce the number of people who can access.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heavenly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A Paradise on earth. You can enjoy a magnificent sea and knowing that it is the place that will give life to sea turtles makes this place even more special.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The top of the top
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful seas that can be found, both in Italy and in the world. Crystal clear water with a thousand shades that always leaves you breathless

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rabbit Island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a long way to get there, if you don't have shoes for rocks, don't try. arrived in front of the island to enter the lawn cost 10 euros sandwich with raw salamella

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One morning at the rabbit beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I recommend booking online on the site, it's free. But if there is no more space, if you arrive half an hour before opening there are 150 seats available for free entry.If you have a reservation, avoid the queue. You descend along a route with breathtaking views. Beach protected by the environmental league which allows you to enter based on two entrances from 8.30/13.30 - 14.30-18.30.As soon as you get off they will explain the rules of the beach such as you cannot smoke.. etcSpectacular water with magnificent colorsIt's absolutely worth it 🏝️❤️the most beautiful in Lampedusa

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dream sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking view and sea…You can't go to Lampedusa and not see the rabbit beach...10 minute walk...very long beach...we went at 5pm and it was wonderful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Goosebump-inducing colours
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect beach for skindiving.White sand and crystal clear water and lots of marine life to explore. No boats will disturb you, depth at the buoys 18 m.Remember to book one of the two shifts available each day or show up early in the morning.Bring plenty of water to drink, there are no refreshments and the climb during the central hours can be tiring for the less trained.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Naturalistic beach where no boat can be accessed and for this reason it is also worth visiting. Crystal clear water with a thousand little fish swimming around you. Reachable via a path, by reservation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have been living by beach places for almost all my life, but this location definitively caught my attention! What an amazing place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Closer to the sun and sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can be Maldives, it could be an island of nowhere in the Indian Ocean… it could be but is not. It is the Italian territory of Lampedusa, just an hour flight from Napoli. The place is absolutely non-European all the way, and it should not be, 155 km away from North Africa. On a more pragmatic matter, the sea is green smarald & blue and it is heavienly. Beech fairly regular and I am not keen on Italian style of people sitting on top of each other on the sand. I suggest not taking an umbrella and spend the time just in the water … at the end ne of the day, this is the real attraction!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jolie
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Très jolie plage. Propre. Eau turquoise. on se croirant dans les caraïbes.Attention si vous avez des enfants, il faut marcher 20 minutes environ....Sinon c'est à faire magnifique. Nous voyions bien les poissons.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Il paradiso può attendere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Il paradiso. Supera di gran lunga le fotografie. Acqua tipo vasca da bagno (anche troppo) snorkeling intorno all’isola suggestivo. Pesci amici dell’uomo, lì si sentono protetti, e lo sono! Una volta nella vita va vista, tutto il resto è noia (ma non le spiagge di Lampedusa)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradiso
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Una delle più belle spiagge italiane.Accessibile con prenotazione on line (150 i posti liberi senza) dopo un breve stradello facile da percorrere una volta arrivati avrete la visione di un paradiso per chi ama il mare.Spiaggia di sabbia bianca e sulla sinistra possibilità di fare snorkeling in un luogo unico.Per chi volesse, possibilità di noleggiare un ombrellone in cima alla via.Se siete sull’isola non potete perdervela.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mare cristallino e panorama mozzafiato
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In assoluto la spiaggia più bella che i miei occhi hanno avuto la fortuna di ammirare!Il colore cristallino dell'acqua combinato con le rocce e il verde intorno, dona alla spiaggia un'aria davvero magica e suggestiva.Il mare rimane basso per un lungo tratto, rendendolo a tutti gli effetti come una strada in cui passeggiare.Consiglio anche attività di snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Un paradiso
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Da vedere assolutamente! Un mare spettacolare , per chi ama lo snorkeling suggerisco di portare maschera e pinne e di spingersi vicino alle rocce.Non è una spiaggia attrezzata quindi munitevi di ombrellone, teli e soprattutto cibo e acqua. Andate presto perché il numero di persone è limitato e nel giro di un'ora potrebbero chiudere gli ingressi.BELLISSIMA!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Best Beach in the Mediterranean Sea (Italian island, Africa island on geographic point of view)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach of the island by far, but also the busiest one. By walk it takes about 15 minutes from the street down to go there. It opens at 8.30.If it is constantly rated the best beach in 'Europe' it must be a reason!The water and colour of the sand are so unique. Speechless.Lampedusa has also the advantage of having a convenient airport to travel from Catania or Palermo, and the norther airports on summer time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I Caraibi in Italia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Se è stata votata quale spiaggia più bella d’Europa, beh un motivo ci sarà. Siamo arrivati alla Spiaggia dei Conigli carichi di aspettative, che fortunatamente non sono state disattese. La passeggiata di venti minuti per giungere alla spiaggia non è pesante (io l’ho sempre fatta con infradito, nessuna difficoltà). La vista dall’alto è assolutamente spettacolare. Prima di arrivare alla spiaggia potrete ammirare la vecchia casa di Domenico Modugno (che affaccia proprio su questo paradiso). Portate ombrellone e viveri per tutto il giorno perché serviranno. Non ci sono punti di ristoro (tranne quello al parcheggio). Non dimenticate maschera o occhialini, il paesaggio subacqueo è meraviglioso. Tantissimi pesci, di varie specie, poi ricci, granchi... insomma, un vero e proprio Eden per chi ama fare snorkeling. Unica nota dolente, la passeggiata fatta in discesa al mattino, dovrete rifarla in salita al pomeriggio. Diventa impegnativa e un po’ faticosa. Ma non lasciatevi spaventare. Ne vale assolutamente la pena! La spiaggia dei Conigli vi conquisterà!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Una delle spiagge più belle d' Italia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Questa spiaggia è davvero bellissima, colori stupendi, mare ricco di tantissimi pesciolini, ideale per chi ama lo snorkeling. Conviene andare la mattina presto perché purtroppo si riempie facilmente .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of The best beach in Europe, you can lost to visit that! It suggests to visit with child during afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crowded, long walk, but definitely worth to visit! Prepare yourself with snack and water, plan to stay longer as the walk is quite long. Better if you have a closed shoes with you for the walk. Spectacular view, crystal clear water. Few jellyfishes, but you need to be careful with the transparent ones, the big browns with blue dots are harmless, so much that you can actually touch them (not sure how much they like that though...)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relax in paradiso
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Obbligatorio andarci se si è a Lampedusa perché è davvero incantevole. Noi siamo stati ieri 21 luglio. Occhio però alla discesa su terreno in parte in pietra e dissestato, e soprattutto alla faticosa salita 15 min a scendere, mezz'oretta a salire se non siete affatto sportivi come me), pertanto:1) per me fondamentali scarpe da ginnastica anche se ho visto scendere e salire tanti con le infradito. Ma perché rischiare una caduta e rovinarsi la vacanza?2) consigliatissimo arrivare presto alla mattina (io sono arrivata alle 9 e c'erano già tanti ombrelloni, ma ancora parecchio posto) oppure nel pomeriggio dopo le 17 (per il sole non più così forte x la discesa). Tante persone dopo pranzo son già andate via (ma sconsigliatissimo farsi quella salita con quel sole!!!!). Gli orari sono 8.30-19.30.3) le regole dicono che si può stare solo in una parte di spiaggia, per pericolo di caduta massi nell'altro pezzo. Questo è quello che ci ha detto un ragazzo di legambiente, ed è quanto indicato in un cartello fuori, quindi a quanto pare niente cause legate alle tartarugue come ho letto da qualche parte. Chiaramente una volta occupata la prima parte gli altri arrivati dopo han tutti occupato la parte "proibita". Questo ha fatto sì però che ci fosse un buono spazio ciascuno per ombrellone e teli mare. 4) fondamentale avere un ombrellone. Se non lo avete lo potete noleggiare al bar all'ingresso.Il sole picchia davvero duro.5) crema solare protezione alta!! Non preoccupatevi dell'abbronzatura perché ho visto gente con protezione 50 abbronzarsi su questa spiaggia! Noi abbiamo messo sempre protezione 20 e non siamo MAI stati al sole se non quando in acqua e abbiamo rischiato di bruciarci. 6) per i motivi sopra, non andateci al primo giorno. Meglio avere già un minimo strato di abbronzatura o una pelle già scura.7) portatevi tanta acqua (oltre ai viveri), non avevamo la borsa frigo ma congelarla la notte prima è bastato per tenerla fredda tutto il gg. Una volta arrivati giù non troverete niente: bere, bagni ecc.. 8) ideale arrivarci in motorino (così come girare tutta l'isola con questo mezzo). Parcheggio a pagamento, all'ingresso rilasciano la ricevuta con relativa targa. 3.50 euro intera giornata oppure 0.70 euro l'ora. Per le auto non conosco i prezzi. Presente anche la fermata dell'autobus.9) maschera da snorkeling molto consigliata, vedrete pesci anche di una certa dimensione nuotarvi intorno appena entrati in acqua. L'acqua è poco profonda fino ad un bel pezzo, quindi ideale anche per bimbi o chi non sa nuotare. Noi non abbiamo visto nessuna medusa. Nonostante la folla di gente lo spazio di mare antistante è grande e ci siamo goduti parecchia tranquillità.10) no cani randagi in spiaggia. Sembra un consiglio banale ma per chi come me è stato in altre parti di Sicilia e ha avuto gli incubi di tirar fuori un panino per la comparsa sul proprio telo di un cane che ti guardava con lo sguardo famelico, ecco direi che qui può stare tranquillo. Avevo letto articoli di un paio di anni fa che sembrava fosse un grosso problema qui a Lampedusa ma sembra anche che l'abbiano abbastanza risolto. E finora a parte un paio a fine giornata in un'altra cala non ne ho visti molti.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sight and beach to enjoy good times!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches to visit in the world, you will never forget great views and clean environment!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: una delle più belle davvero

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Il paradiso deve essere più o meno così...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Siamo stati a Lampedusa in settembre e la visita alla SPIAGGIA DEI CONIGLI non poteva mancare. C'è il parcheggio da pagare.. costo irrisorio. Eravamo li alle 8 e già c'era gente che SCALPITAVA per arrivare per prima in spiaggia (e già mi innervosisco). Bella la passeggiata che si apre in certi punti a panorami mozzafiato se non commoventi. La spiaggia è bianca e sembra irreale. E' divisa per chi ha l'ombrellone e per chi non ce l'ha. Se volete fumare si lascia la spiaggia. Dovrebbero mettere un cartello perchè non si capisce bene che non si può fumare. Noi eravamo preparati e sapevamo cosa dovevamo fare ma c'è gente che se ne frega di tutto.. MALEDUCATI! Legambiente supervisiona il tutto e cerca di far rispettare le regole.. ma ripeto: E' pieno di MALEDUCATI che non meriterebbero neanche di avvicinarsi a posti del genere.Il mare è da sogno.. ottimo per lo snorkeling. Ci sono un sacco di pesci da vedere. Non do 4 stelle solo perchè c'è troppa gente. Essendo AREA PROTETTA non dovrebbero far arrivare così tanta gente in spiaggia. Proporrei un NUMERO CHIUSO o magari un mega pagamento per entrare. TROPPA GENTE MALEDUCATA CHE LASCIA SPORCO e poi si lamentano che non vedono le tartarughe o che è sporco (sveglioni). BUFFONI! Questo non è il posto per voi. Sarebbe un PARADISO.. il posto è MAGNIFICO. Portatevi acqua e cibo.. altrimenti vi dovete fare la sgambata fino all'ONDA BLU.

Difficile da dimenticare!

reviews.title: Icon of Lampedusa
reviews.text: World famous as it is considered among the 10 most beautiful on the planet and in 2013 the people of Tripadvisor elected it first. I do not know if this assessment is correct (you should have seen all the beaches in the world to judge and then each of us has its own criteria) but undoubtedly it is a beautiful beach: a long and wide beach of fine white sand, shallow water for dozens of meters, crystal clear and wonderful colors, mainly various shades of green. Here you do not swim but walk in the water back and forth, magnetized by that thin strip of submerged sand that connects the beach to the Isola dei Conigli, which can be easily reached by walking in the water but where it is forbidden to climb, as if enchanted by so much beauty and the emotion of being in an exclusive place, very interesting Nature, for the presence of the aforementioned islet and the absence of establishments and other buildings (except for the villa of Domenico Modugno, located in a recess of the beach but practically hidden).  To reach this paradise you have to walk a path of about 800 meters, however well arranged that is therefore very well done (perhaps a little 'tiring on the way back since it is uphill) and that starts from the road of West, where there is a bar / refreshment and parking (for a fee) as well as the stop of the Blue Line Bus and access controls: the beach is in fact limited in number and the entrance must be booked online in advance; there are two shifts, morning (8:30-13:30) or afternoon (14:30-19:30); the morning shift has the disadvantage of making the path uphill at the hottest time; the booking procedure is quite simple and intuitive, and works well, you just have to make the reservation in advance, which is difficult to quantify as it depends on the period. In any case, it is good to know that if you can not book on the chosen day because both rounds are already sold out, there are a hundred places available without reservation and that are assigned on the basis of the order of presentation at the access box (so if you want to be sure to enter just show up at the box "access not booked" well in advance of the start of the shift, morning or afternoon.

reviews.title: Rabbit Beach: an earthly paradise (with some care)
reviews.text: The Spiaggia dei Conigli is undoubtedly one of the jewels of the Mediterranean, a place where unspoilt nature gives unforgettable emotions. Its fame is well deserved, with crystal clear waters and golden sand that invite relaxation and contemplation.Key tips:Reservation required: Throughout the summer, access to the beach is regulated and requires advance booking, especially in July and August, when the island is particularly crowded. Plan your visit well in advance to secure your place in this paradise.Time slots: The beach is accessible in two time slots:Morning: from 8:30 to 13:30. The water is particularly clear and crystal clear, ideal for snorkelers and divers. However, the ascent from the beach requires a walk of about 20 minutes uphill, under the sun.Afternoon: from 14:30 to 19:30. The water is slightly less transparent, but still gorgeous. Sunset from the beach is a magical experience.Prepare for the ascent: Regardless of the time slot you choose, the ascent from the beach takes a bit of effort. Bring enough water with you and wear comfortable shoes.No sunbeds and umbrellas: the beach is not equipped, you can bring only your own umbrella.What makes Rabbit Beach special:The natural beauty: The landscape is breathtaking, with colors ranging from the intense turquoise of the water to the white of the sand.Biodiversity: The beach is a protected area, where you can spot different marine and terrestrial species.Despite the need for booking and the somewhat challenging ascent, the Spiaggia dei Conigli is definitely worth a visit.

The moment you look out over this cove the colors are fantastic of a blue you have never seen unless you have been to the Maldives or other exotic places for the super rich. I can assure you that all the photos you see on the web are not realistic, they do not show the real colors of that sea. They can't reproduce the emotions you get when you're there.On the shore, even in just one meter of water there are a myriad of fish including breams, salps, murmurs, amberjacks even 50 cm long... in short, you are in an open-air aquarium, you are in the marine nature reserve of Lampedusa! Unforgettable

reviews.title: A Tropical Dream on Sicily
reviews.text: Spiaggia dei Conigli, or Rabbit Beach, is located on the idyllic island of Lampedusa, part of the Italian island group Pelagie. With its crystal clear turquoise water and soft, white sandy beaches, Spiaggia dei Conigli is considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. For anyone who dreams of a perfect beach day, this place is a true paradise.Natural BeautyWhen you first arrive at Spiaggia dei Conigli, you will be welcomed by a spectacular view. The long, white sandy beach embraces the clear water, and the cliffs surrounding the beach provide a dramatic and scenic background. The landscape is amazing and it feels like you have entered a postcard world. The beach is also surrounded by protected areas, which are home to a variety of animal species, including sea turtles breeding here, making the place even more unique and giving a feeling of being in harmony with nature.Activities and RelaxationSpiaggia dei Conigli is perfect for both relaxation and activity. The water is calm and clear, making it ideal for swimming, snorkeling and other water sports activities. Snorkeling here is an experience in itself, as it is possible to see colorful fish and exciting marine life. For those looking for a more relaxed day, there is plenty of space to lie down on the sand and enjoy the sun.However, it is important to note that the beach can become very popular, especially during the high season. It is recommended to arrive early in the day to ensure a good seat. Also, there are no facilities directly on the beach, so it is advisable to bring your own food and drinks.AvailabilityTo get to Spiaggia dei Conigli, take a short walk from the parking lot. The tour takes about 20-30 minutes and is a simple but scenic route. The somewhat challenging access makes the beach remain relatively calm compared to more accessible beaches, which is a big part of the charm.ConclusionSpiaggia dei Conigli is a hidden gem that really gives you a feeling of being in paradise. The natural beauty, the crystal clear waters and the relaxing atmosphere make this place a must for anyone visiting Lampedusa. Whether you’re looking for adventure, relaxation or a romantic day by the sea, Spiaggia dei Conigli will exceed your expectations. This is a place you won’t forget, and that will definitely give you memories for a lifetime.

The first time we found rough seas due to the wind and we had a great time swimming in the waves. The second time the sea was definitely ok, clear and with fantastic "colors"! The beach is a nature reserve so it is forbidden to leave rubbish or anything else, you can bring your umbrella but not the awnings. We also had the pleasure of seeing the hatching of a Caretta Caretta turtle egg, which, thanks to the help of the boys of the Lega Ambiente was able to reach the shore and jump into the sea. It was a really great experience!The visit to this beach is not recommended for those with particular health problems (see the site) or struggles to walk, because to reach it there is a nice piece of road with pebbles and stones and to go back is all uphill. Going by boat, however, you can admire it only from a distance and then wanting to swim.Parking is on the street, in September the cost was 7.5 euros all afternoon from 2.30 pm to 7 pm. At the entrance you will find a small kiosk selling food and drinks I would say very well cared for.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Heaven! Do not miss, wonderful experience! I am Sicilian but such a sea is a dream for me too. Nature reserve maintained and managed for its maintenance. The route to get there ( walking 15 minutes ) also retains its naturalness and gives a deep sense of its value .

reviews.title: Lampedusa Sicily
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in the world! A nature reserve, spotless beach. This is the pool, guys, not the beach.

reviews.title: Relaxing holiday 2024
reviews.text: Lovely and uncontaminated beach for those who love the sea is a fairy tale the only flaw is the climb and the wait to descend but it is just worth it

reviews.title: Comu jè?? d’agnuni!!
reviews.text: A place that could be the envy of the world, nature has given us a small paradise, unfortunately mistreated by us humans, inhabitants and tourists no one excluded. As the years go by and new generations take over the administration of the island, instead of progressing it recedes. It seems to be in southern Italy 50 years ago with all the problems that have always been added to those gripping the present. You focus on getting a small number of people into rabbits to preserve the environment and then the rest of the island is flooded with mountains of waste, plastic in particular!

reviews.title: Not to be missed
reviews.text: Spectacular spectacular... what can you say spectacular... perfect bookings respected entry times... well maintained trail and climb under the sun... lots of water but worth it

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, clear sea seems to be in the Caribbean, pristine territory, shame to stay only half a day...

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: Crazy beach! Unfortunately, not having the Reservation, we had to arrive there at 7am just to be sure we fit into the 150 seats without Reservation, but it was worth it.

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: Wonderful just as described. For those who love snorkeling you can see numerous fish including very large bream. It is accessed with a 10-minute walk and at least for August there is a double shift. I could not book and showing up an hour before the time I entered without problems.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: The best beach in Lampedusa and not only there!Too bad is overcrowded ( even with the limited accessibility).It takes a 12 -13 minutes walk to reach the beach from the checkpoint .Even if you have booked your entrance slot, I strongly recommend to arrive earlier because the best thing is to be among the first to reach the beach and enjoy this amazing beauty of nature!One of the 3 /4 places in Lampedusa where the colonization of sun beds has not arrived ( and hopefully never will ).

reviews.title: WONDERFUL
reviews.text: Paradise on Earth...great idea to put the entrance by Reservation on two shifts to be able to enjoy the best of this exceptional place unique in the world. Crystal clear sea on one side and an area with a cliff on the other. On the beach there are the nests of the caretta caretta turtle presided over by the volunteers of Legambiente emotions on emotions. Highly recommended but remember to have the utmost respect for this lovely place. To get there there there is a downhill road to the sea and on the way back the climb is challenging but feasible.

reviews.title: Spectacular sea
reviews.text: The month of August is penalizing. To access the beach always row both matt and afternoon shift .Without Reservation row right arrival just before 8am and by / start to descend to the beach (about 1/4 hour of fairly steep road) around 8.35am.  The view of the beach and the sea are amazing. Unfortunately very crowded. At 1.30pm you must be at the exit. In any case it is worth it.

reviews.title: Sea without equal
reviews.text: Limited access beach, not having been able to book, I preferred to go at 7 am, in the middle of August, to get in line in the 150 places dedicated to residents who in this period are usually busy working. The descent anticipates a breathtaking panorama.The beach is divided between those who want to put umbrella (rentable next to the parking lot) and those who do notBehind the volunteers check the nests for the hatching of caretta caretta turtles.Sea of unparalleled transparency. Possibility of snorkeling along the cliffs.Wonderful. The 1pm ascent is made more difficult by the hot August sun, I suggest water supply.Next to the parking lot, a kiosk cafe restaurant where you can enjoy breakfast and lunch.Behind the same present bathrooms (well maintained)Access from 8.30-13.30 and 14.30-18.30

reviews.title: Love at first sight
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches seen so far in all of Europe. Thanks to the limited number you can enjoy its beauty without having to find yourself under the umbrella or on someone else's towel. As mentioned in other reviews, the line for those who have booked runs quickly, for those who have not done so and still try to access is still waiting for shelter under several tents. Seen in both the morning and afternoon shifts, the most difficult part is the ascent, especially after the 1.30pm shift. By that time you must already be up at the entrance, so better leave around 13 - 13.10 maximum. Closed shoes recommended, the road is partly composed of more or less large stones and steps.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: The beach is definitely beautiful, although I found it overrated compared to other reviews read here and elsewhere. The same type of "view" is also found in other Italian locations, perhaps less famous.    The sore point of August is the absurd amount of people who give access to the beach that does not allow in any way to enjoy it serenely.  Rudeness is unfortunately king. To reach the beach there is a dirt path of about 15/20 minutes, closed shoes are recommended. There are no beach facilities for food or drink.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach reachable with a 15-minute walk downhill. The line for those who booked runs very fast. Umbrellas can only be used in one area of the beach. Beach not equipped but has a bar at the entrance

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful but to book , we did it two months before and it is good because some tourists could not see it. It deserves to see it from above and swim in its crystal clear waters, for those who are lucky could meet some turtle that comes out of the sand, we were obviously not 😅. One part of the beach is accessible with only beach towels, the other side also umbrellas. The walk to the beach and in good 15 min walk under the sun, arm yourself with a hat and do not carry too much weight. During routes there are benches to stop in the shade, however admiring the enchanting panorama the climb passes quickly. We have chosen Reservation at 8:30/13:30 , the other slot is from 14:30/19:30. Obviously there are no beaches or bars but at the entrance, before the route, there is a kiosk for drinks and more.

reviews.title: SPECTACULAR OF NATURE
reviews.text: This beach is really a paradise on earth... surreal from how beautiful it is, if you come to lampedusa is a must.Reservation is required on the site to access it, Recommendation the time slot of the afternoon 14.30 / 19.30 because the climb back in the sun at 14 is not the best.the path is not long; it lasts about 15 minutes and shoes are recommended because with flip-flops you slide, parking is charged € 5 and there is the possibility to rent umbrellasthanks to the limited access there is no overcrowding, it is very quiet and not everyone is stuck.

reviews.title: S T R E P I T O S A
reviews.text: Arrived for the morning shift without Reservation (sold out online, 150 seats for non-reserved).We queue (not the first row you find on the left (are booked) the row on the right and wait confidently....ok done you enter.Walk, walk and walk (tracking shoes or gymnastics recommended not to get hurt) for 30 minutes.... but then you appear in all its immense, infinite, rare, amazing, extraordinary beauty!!!Take your breath away!!!!!!Modugno was right: it is the pool of God😍.  ANDATECI!!!!!!!

reviews.title: The wonder
reviews.text: I return after six years to this beach that you can not miss if you are in Lampedusa. The last time I was there it was free and I had done all day, now you can only do half a day. We did not book there was no place, we went in the morning Recommendation to go around 7.30, get in line, they will start to drop off after 8.30. Recommendation to go in the morning because waiting in the sun for the afternoon would be too hard. Go down with the tennis, remember that you have to bring the umbrella or rent it at the parking bar which is for a fee, there is no bathroom and bar below so bring the necessary and you can not smoke. It's 6 minutes of descent and 10 minutes of ascent, feasible for anyone. We returned in the afternoon, at 17 descents without any line without any problem but of course Recommendation in the morning for the colors of the sea. Not to be missed

reviews.title: What about it? Just go there!!!
reviews.text: Years have passed, when on the beach you could only put the towel on the ground and access it without appointment.It is clear that tourism changes and places are discovered. I certainly preferred it when there were few, but this beach deserves to be visited and to enjoy its beauty.Book quietly the visit that you will not regret.Being in Lampedusa and not having visited this place, is really a shame.Have a nice swim!!!!

reviews.title: Open air swimming pool
reviews.text: I was at this beach without Reservation presented at 8 immense row at 08:40 I was already descending the 800 meter path that leads to the show the view takes your breath away The water has spectacular colors to return as I did at 16:30 just the time to take another bath really deserves

reviews.title: Dream made beach
reviews.text: There is little to say, the beach symbol of Lampedusa, an earthly paradise: clear water, white sand.Perhaps to achieve maximum success we need to reduce a little the number of people allowed access in the two shifts(P.S. Make your online reservation to access)

reviews.title: ONE THING IS SURE I'LL COME BACK
reviews.text: The Spiaggia dei Conigli, being a natural reserve of the island that is part of the Pelagie archipelago in Sicily, is considered one of the wonders of the world. “White sandy beaches, turquoise water and refreshing sea breeze. Take a good shoe and prepare for a walk of about twenty minutes to reach it, but when you “come there, you will feel that you are not on Earth”, it was our feeling and you do not want to come away...ONE THING IS SURE I'LL COME BACK

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Paradise on earth... pristine place and absolute relaxation ..Fresh fish and nice people.. To return absolutely

reviews.title: Rudeness and disorganization of staff
reviews.text: Obviously the location is 5 stars, needless to say the sea that is certainly one of the most beautiful ever seen. Beyond that my experience was bad. I regularly made the reservation to enter the afternoon slot but arrived there they would not let us in, justifying the fact that we were well past the deadline to enter. My mistake ok, maybe I was distracted when I received the booking confirmation email. Or maybe they are not too clear since like me there were many other people who came "beyond" the bell. After a heated discussion we still managed to enter but I still wanted to report the rudeness and ignorance of a girl at the entrance, who mocked mocking anyone, raising the tone considerably, showing her professionalism in its entirety.Even on the beach I witnessed shocking scenes, staff running around arrogantly mocking tourists... I was really upset.I believe that places with a strong tourist attraction like this should be given in management to those who really have quality and great professionalism to do it, no to improvised...I really hope for a change of course, maybe next time I will find more welcome.

reviews.title: A dream beach...
reviews.text: Spectacular beach. Easy enough access and very clean water and full of fish. Almeno una volta bisogna vederla!!

reviews.title: Beach of Rabbits
reviews.text: Paradise on earth, never seen such beauty. I'll never forget her. Too bad for the queue to do, I would have come back another time before leaving. Once in a lifetime must be seen

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Lovely place, crystal clear and warm water, breathtaking scenery around, the wild beauty of the place makes you forget the slight effort to reach it

reviews.title: Test holiday
reviews.text: Fairytale nature reserve, visit time and 5 hours , which are largely sufficient, offer portable umbrella service , necessary, the waiting line is worth it

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Only this beach is worth the trip. It is a spectacle, every time it leaves you speechless. To see both in the morning and in the afternoon because the lights are different as they change according to the wind. Right that it is a nature reserve to allow limited access and preserve this wonder. Ps: road feasible even with flip-flops.Excessive only the price of parking the car.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa !!!
reviews.text: Nonostante il maestrale, spiaggia davvero bella....mare dai mille colori!!!! There are no words x describe it To return when there is little wind

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: It's the most beautiful beach I've ever seen. Going down you are left speechless and with bated breath so much the unexpected beauty that opens to the view. The sea is a mix of wonderful colors, more crystal clear than a pool. We booked through the site but access is also allowed to a limited number of people without reservation. The ascent is a bit challenging and I do not recommend it in the hottest hours. At the top there is a small bar where you can find some refreshment.

reviews.title: Worth at least once
reviews.text: beautiful, pristine beach with lots of fish, even some dogs on the beach. It is not possible to access it with deckchairs, lifebuoys etc. but only the umbrella that you have to bring from home or rent upstairs. The descent is almost 900 m and the ascent is a bit hard, but sometimes there are small shaded areas to rest. It is always better to go down with shoes or at most hiking sandals. You can stop only half a day and it is free. But parking in June is charged € 1.50 per hour. for once it is worth it. There are no services, lifeguard bars at beach level but only at the top of the climb.

reviews.title: MERAVIGLIOSA!
reviews.text: I turned enough, but such a beautiful place I had never seen it! Indescrivibile!Da visitare e rimandare incantati!

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: It's not describable, A BEAUTY OF NATURE there are beauties that cannot be explained, You have to see them from people to appreciate them

reviews.title: Exaggerated!
reviews.text: It is impossible to tell it, it is useless to photograph it. You would never be able to be faithful to reality. When you are there you immerse yourself in its magic and time stops. Just take it all and believe in fairy tales. The rest comes by itself!

reviews.title: Uuuuuuu
reviews.text: A bomb!!! There's a walk to do but it's about 800m, nothing impossible... the beach and the sea repay the effort!!! Simply breathtaking and there was also a rough sea.... I imagine when it is calm

reviews.title: The best beach in Lampedusa
reviews.text: We go for three consecutive days of our short holiday on the island, we immediately understand that it is the most popular half, it is very easy to park and there is no need for a reservation, but it is a bit early as it is the first week of May.To reach the beach there is a cobbled path which, honestly, in the sun, going up it is very tiring. The beach and the sea are beautiful, it's a shame about an old rusty boat that is dangerous for children located on the side of the beach.

reviews.title: But what do Italians go to the Maldives for?
reviews.text: I thought that "Paradise" was above; but instead it is below, on the same level as us and reachable not necessarily by having performed good deeds on Earth. It is the "Rabbit Beach", with the islet of the same name opposite, Lampedusa : a hymn to the beauty of Nature at sea. And so Sicily adds this authentic "enchantment" to its historical, archaeological and artistic wonders!

reviews.title: It will leave you speechless...
reviews.text: Said and said again... but I'll say it again: Conigli beach is Heaven on Earth. To be preserved. Crazy colours...sea to drink...extreme beauty.On the beach you have to follow rules (rightly so); cigarettes (rightly) are not allowed. The Legambiente volunteers do an excellent job. Great.You can enter for shifts that can be booked online (do it well in advance). There are 2 shifts per day and, if desired, there is also a queue for those without reservations. Places are not unlimited.You will not regret it. A single recommendation: respect for this Paradise. I would go back 10 thousand times.

reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text: Just amazing, I hope they continue to preserve it.Crystal clear water, the approach from the path is very suggestive.

reviews.title: UNIQUE
reviews.text: God's swimming pool. That's how Modugno defines it, well he's not entirely wrong......best beach I've ever visited

reviews.title: UNSURPASSABLE!
reviews.text: we booked access well in advance on the "rabbit beach entrance booking" website. entry is free; I recommend arriving by early afternoon in order to fully enjoy this incredible show! it is possible to stay on the beach for a limited time (I don't remember exactly how many hours; maybe 3 hours?) we parked the scooter nearby for €3.50. above the beach there is a bar. there are no words to describe this cove. top top top!

reviews.title: best time to visit it
reviews.text: if you are lucky with the weather, October is the best time to go to Lampedusa, no chaos, pleasant temperatures, warm and crystal clear sea.Then taking the walk to get to the rabbit beach under a beautiful sun but without the torrid climate is certainly more advisable.Stunning island that should be protected (in addition to the rabbit island) to avoid the reckless abandonment of various rubbish on the coasts and roadsides.

reviews.title: An experience to repeat
reviews.text: Splendid beach with crystal clear water, the colors of the sea are enchanting, the climb up under the 1pm sun is a bit challenging but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: What can we say about a one-of-a-kind wonder..!! A fantastic beach, a wonderful, one-of-a-kind island, the best I've ever seen so far

reviews.title: Heaven is here
reviews.text: Paradise experience... Color of the water, care of the beach, protection of the fauna: these are the aspects that I appreciated most.

reviews.title: Suddenly Paradise
reviews.text: Simply a paradise.Simple booking, convenient parking and a path where every step opens up to a glimpse of a picture that only nature could create.

reviews.title: What a sea
reviews.text: A true paradiseCrystal clear water, beach and spectacular viewsSimple booking to makeYou go down a path for 10 minutes and you find yourself facing a sea that leaves you breathless

reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text: I was at Conigli beach in mid-August and there really aren't enough photos or words to give an idea of what a natural spectacle it is. I was very happy that I had to book and that there was a limited number of places, otherwise I don't think I would have enjoyed it so much. Stunning sea, not too crowded, very fine sandy beach. The walk to get there is slightly tiring when you go up (especially in the hottest hours I recommend lots of fresh water). A mandatory stop for anyone coming to Lampedusa!

reviews.title: Enchanting
reviews.text: There is a reason why it is among the most beautiful beaches in the world.Entrance must be booked online. Better to do it in advance so as not to risk losing the chance to visit it

reviews.title: An authentic enchantment
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have seen, with a wonderful sea. It is difficult to describe in words the wonder of this place. Absolutely worth seeing

reviews.title: Magnificence of nature
reviews.text: Magnificence of nature, fortunately not yet ruined by man, thanks to the volunteers of Legambiente.I recommend booking on the Legambiente website to avoid waiting.It is also advisable to arrive early, no later than 8.30am to enjoy the uncrowded beach.

reviews.title: Paradise in Earth
reviews.text: Having arrived on the island for two days with my husband, we decide not to wait any longer and immediately go and visit what is the main reason for our trip here! Well what can I tell you... I don't know where else in the world I can see a sea like this... the photos don't do it justice, I'm not very capable of it, if my daughter had been with me she would have given space to her passion! Unfortunately, it's worth the expensive flight. Heaven on earth, you are now in my heart.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Wonderful. If you don't have a reservation, the day with the lowest attendance is Saturday followed by Sunday. In the morning there is less queue

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Magnificent experience, heavenly beach, I recommend being punctual with your booking because there are multiple shifts and it's really worth enjoying it calmly

reviews.title: fantastic show
reviews.text: Area with limited access.Paid street parking (7.00 euros for the car – 3.50 for the motorbike).For access methods, it is essential to inform yourself well in advance on the Lega Ambiente website and to book online equally in advance to obtain the barcode needed to enter (free).The visit is allowed only for half a day (either morning or afternoon) once a week.It is worth knowing that it is still possible to access the beach even without a reservation, but this is allowed to "only" 150 people per shift (morning from 8.30am - afternoon from 2.30pm).From the entrance checkpoint to the beach you go down for about 15 minutes.From the beach to the check, on the way back up (under the hot sun) it takes at least 20/25 minutes.The beach is divided into three areas: the first part (wider) also accessible with an umbrella, the second only with towels (no umbrella), the third inaccessible for environmental protection.The beach is not equipped and there is no possibility of purchasing water or food (bringing at least one bottle of water is strongly recommended).Once all these complications are over… the show is fantastic and totally worth the trip.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Nothing to say about the breathtaking view but I for my part would ask for it completely because sooner or later man will make it ugly.

reviews.title: A daydream.
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen.Crystal clear water. A paradise, a dream. Gorgeous, pristine sand.

reviews.title: The Caribbean at your fingertips!
reviews.text: Wonderful! I Nothing to envy of the Caribbean! ... and everything at your fingertips. Super recommended!!!!

reviews.title: A highly recommended paradise for experiencing the best holidays in the world
reviews.text: If you want to enjoy the most beautiful sea in the world, all you have to do is come to Lampedusa and above all visit the rabbit island: be careful, you need to book in advance as being a reserve, entrances are limited, I'll just tell you that two eyes are not enough to admire the beauty of the crystalline and clear sea, the Sicilian Caribbean

reviews.title: Top 🔝🔝🔝
reviews.text: You can't go to Lampedusa and not see the beach on Rabbit Island. To book in advance on the site for free either in the morning or afternoon or queue before the entry time (max 150 people).About 800m of well-maintained route and you see a marvel

reviews.title: The most beautiful in the world
reviews.text: Never seen such a wonderful sea, beautiful beach, a real swimming pool. The wait and the journey to get there is nerve-wracking but it's worth it. I did the route wearing flip flops, you just need to walk slowly and in 10 minutes you arrive at the beach to enjoy the beauty of nature. Rating 10/10 unique experience

reviews.title: The beauty of the island
reviews.text: It is truly the most beautiful part of the island, thanks above all to the landscape but also to the lack of urbanization that has been prevented there (although I still managed to build a beautiful building facing the sea). Limited access, to be booked in advance during the busiest periods of tourists otherwise you risk not entering.Applause to the legambiente staff who try to keep the area as intact as possible for the life cycle of the turtles.

reviews.title: Top beach. The images speak.
reviews.text: Not much to say, one of the most beautiful beaches I've seen. The images speak. Beautiful. We booked directly there after a bit of waiting, you take a walk in the sun but not too demanding and then you go to the beach. All very beautiful.

reviews.title: Too bad it's overcrowded
reviews.text: Spectacular beach, Caribbean sea. However, there is little respect for the rules (everyone ate the impossible, drank and smoked). Above all, overcrowded: what's the point of making reservations if you then let everyone in? In the end today (August 17th), we were on top of each other in an unbearable mess. After less than 3 hours we left out of exasperation

reviews.title: Book access to the beach!
reviews.text: You need to book your visit on the appropriate site, choosing either the morning or afternoon shift. The first has the drawback that at 1pm, with the sun shining brightly, you find yourself walking the uphill path and it is very tiring; the afternoon shift is better, so the ascent takes place in the late afternoon, at a more bearable temperature. However, in addition to the reserved places, there are also 150 free places, so at the end of June it was possible to enter even without a reservation; in August I imagine it's impossible. These limited accesses are however useful because they have managed to keep the beauty of this beach intact which remains one of the most beautiful I have ever seen (and I have seen many). Bring cash to pay for parking because they don't have a POS.

reviews.title: Paradise on earth
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with crystal clear sea. The idea of regulated access is nice but in my opinion there are still too many people, they should reduce the number of people who can access.

reviews.title: Wonderful but a distant memory
reviews.text: I understand the protection of the place but for those who come to Lampedusa learning that they have to book to visit it leaves bitterness. August is completely full so leave without seeing it. Not even a photo can be taken.

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: A Paradise on earth. You can enjoy a magnificent sea and knowing that it is the place that will give life to sea turtles makes this place even more special.

reviews.title: The top of the top
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful seas that can be found, both in Italy and in the world. Crystal clear water with a thousand shades that always leaves you breathless

reviews.title: Rabbit Island
reviews.text: It's a long way to get there, if you don't have shoes for rocks, don't try. arrived in front of the island to enter the lawn cost 10 euros sandwich with raw salamella

reviews.title: One morning at the rabbit beach
reviews.text: I recommend booking online on the site, it's free. But if there is no more space, if you arrive half an hour before opening there are 150 seats available for free entry.If you have a reservation, avoid the queue. You descend along a route with breathtaking views. Beach protected by the environmental league which allows you to enter based on two entrances from 8.30/13.30 - 14.30-18.30.As soon as you get off they will explain the rules of the beach such as you cannot smoke.. etcSpectacular water with magnificent colorsIt's absolutely worth it 🏝️❤️the most beautiful in Lampedusa

reviews.title: Dream sea
reviews.text: Breathtaking view and sea…You can't go to Lampedusa and not see the rabbit beach...10 minute walk...very long beach...we went at 5pm and it was wonderful

reviews.title: Goosebump-inducing colours
reviews.text: Perfect beach for skindiving.White sand and crystal clear water and lots of marine life to explore. No boats will disturb you, depth at the buoys 18 m.Remember to book one of the two shifts available each day or show up early in the morning.Bring plenty of water to drink, there are no refreshments and the climb during the central hours can be tiring for the less trained.

reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: Naturalistic beach where no boat can be accessed and for this reason it is also worth visiting. Crystal clear water with a thousand little fish swimming around you. Reachable via a path, by reservation.

reviews.title: Da non perdere
